rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question about their response to the messengers is one of awe; bewilderment removes discernment, reason, and the ability to answer.
rows.anchor: يسألهم سؤال هيبة ؛ فلا يبقى لهم تمييز ، ولا قوة عقل ، ولا مكنة جواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Choice belongs to God, who chooses whom He wills from creation; creatures without any share in creating have no rightful claim to choose independently.
rows.anchor: يختار ما يشاء ومن يشاء من جملة ما يخلق . ومن ليس إليه شيء من الخلق .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine choice is an attribute of majesty, while human self-asserted choice is deficiency and affliction because the creature is not entitled to it.
rows.anchor: فالاختيار للحق نعت عز ، والاختيار للخلق صفة نقص ونعت بلاء وقصور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's knowledge encompasses all that is known, and creating from nonexistence belongs eternally to His power; this is supported by the question of whether the Creator knows what He created.
rows.anchor: ألا يعلم من خلق وهو اللطيف الخبير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Creation from nothing into existence is an act of power exclusive to God and without beginning.
rows.anchor: والإبداع من العدم إلى الوجود ينفرد بالقدرة عليه لم يزل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone is one in the majesty of His lordship, with no likeness or equal.
rows.anchor: توحد بعز هيبته ، وتفرد بجلال ربوبيته ، لا شبيه يساويه ، ولا نظير يضاهيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God deserves praise for His gifts and thanks for His favor: He is praised in this life and thanked in the next.
rows.anchor: { له الحمد } استحقاقا على عطيته ، وله الشكر استيجابا على نعمته ؛ ففي الدنيا المحمود الله ، وفي العقبى المشكور الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every good comes from God: beneficence follows His sovereignty, blessing His mercy, and victory His power.
rows.anchor: فالإحسان من الله لأن السلطان لله ، والنعمة من الله لأن الرحمة لله ، والنصرة من الله لأن القدرة لله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only God brings the dawn after spiritual nights: repentance after lapse, existence after seeking, expansion after constriction, and union after separation; He also gives the night in which servants rest in seclusion with Him.
rows.anchor: إن دامت ليالي الفترة فمن الذي يأتي بنهار التوبة غير الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When communion's daylight persists, detractors cannot spoil its joy; this too is among the states whose continuance depends on God.
rows.anchor: إن دام في الوصلة نهاركم فأي سبيل للواشين إلى تنغيص سروركم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearing the basmala reaches everyone, sinner or obedient and noble or lowly; listening humbly makes one leave sleep, while listening with longing makes one leave food and drink.
rows.anchor: كلمة سماعها ربيع الجميع ، من العاصي والمطيع ، والشريف والوضيع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The letter alif alludes to lovers' attachment to God's nearness and knowers' intimacy with His praise, which makes them unable to find comfort in anyone else.
rows.anchor: ألف المحبون قربتي فلا يصبرون عني ، وألف العارفون تمجيدي فلا يستأنسون بغيري

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The letter lam points to the meeting God has reserved for His beloved; their shortcomings in loyalty do not cancel that promised meeting.
rows.anchor: لقائي المدخر لأحبائي ، فلا أبالي أقاموا على ولائي أم قصروا في وفائي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The letter mim signifies that God's friends relinquish their own wishes for His, and He therefore favors them over His other servants.
rows.anchor: ترك أوليائي مرادهم لمرادي . . فلذلك آثرتهم على جميع عبادي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When meeting the beloved is unavailable, the revealed Book is their most precious possession: it carries God's message and address, while they remain safe from His punishment.
rows.anchor: إذا تعذر لقاء الأحباب فأعز شيء على الأحباب كتاب ؛ أنزلت على أحبابي كتابي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Time is created, and a created thing need not be created within time: time itself came to be without another time containing it.
rows.anchor: فليس من شرط المخلوق ولا من ضرورته أن يخلقه في وقت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's istiwa over the Throne does not impose a boundary, bodily nearness, or distance on the Eternal; He is peerless and without limit.
rows.anchor: ولكن القديم ليس له حد ، استوى على العرش لكن لا يجوز عليه القرب بالذات ولا البعد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inanimate Throne has no will and could not experience longing for union; God is self-subsisting, peerless, and beyond limit.
rows.anchor: ولكنه أشد الأشياء تعطشا إلى شظية من الوصال لو كان للعرش حياة ؟ ، ولكن العرش جماد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Without God's willing good for people, neither sky, earth, nor any created thing can protect or assist them; the passage addresses realities in language suited to people's understanding.
rows.anchor: إذا لم يرد بكم خيرا فلا سماء عنه تظلكم ، ولا أرض بغير رضاه تقلكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is mighty toward the obedient to break their self-exaltation and merciful toward sinners to lift their lapse.
rows.anchor: للعاصين ليرفع زلتهم . أحسن صورة كل أحد ؛ فالعرش ياقوتة حمراء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author contrasts the splendid forms of creation—ruby Throne, winged angels, Jibril as their peacock, beautiful houris, and gardens—with humanity's humble origin from clay.
rows.anchor: فالعرش ياقوتة حمراء ، والملائكة أولو أجنحة مثنى وثلاث ورباع ، وجبريل طاووس الملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although humans are made from clay, God's love for them gives them a distinction greater than their material origin.
rows.anchor: خلق الإنسان من طين ولكن { يحبهم ويحبونه } [ البقرة : 152 ]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity's clay origin is surpassed by the divine promise to remember those who remember God.
rows.anchor: وخلق الإنسان من طين ولكن : { فاذكرونى أذكركم } [ البينة : 8 ]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humanity's clay origin is surpassed by God's pleasure with His servants and their pleasure with Him.
rows.anchor: وخلق الإنسان من طين ولكن { رضى الله عنهم ورضوا عنه } [ المائدة : 119 ]

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A trace of gnosis, longing, or love would have kept people from obstinately denying that return to God is possible.
rows.anchor: لو كانت لهم ذرة من العرفان ، وشمة من الاشتياق ، ونسمة من المحبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their central denial is disbelief in meeting their Lord, rooted in hearts heedless of divine realities and attached to created causes.
rows.anchor: ولكن قال : { بل هم بلقآء ربهم كافرون } . لولا غفلة قلوبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Angel of Death has no independent effect or control over anyone; taking life belongs uniquely to God's power, though people speak according to their limited understanding and attachment to secondary causes.
rows.anchor: فإن ملك الموت لا أثر منه في أحد ، ولا له تصرفات في نفسه ، وما يحصل من التوفي فمن خصائص قدرة الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People are addressed in language they can bear, according to their strength and weakness; at judgment bewilderment and shame leave them apologizing too late.
rows.anchor: وكل يخاطب بما يحتمل على قدر قوته وضعفه . ملكتهم الدهشة وغلبتهم الخجلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God could have made proof and guidance easy for everyone, but His will distinguishes those led astray from those brought near, with dwellers assigned to both Fire and Garden.
rows.anchor: ولكن تعلقت المشيئة بإغواء قوم ، كما تعلقت بإدناء قوم ، وأردنا أن يكون للنار قطان ، كما أردنا أن يكون للجنة سكان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God cannot will that what He knows will occur fail to occur: otherwise His knowledge would not be knowledge, and it is impossible for Him not to be God.
rows.anchor: فمن المحال أن نريد ألأ يقع معلومنا ، ولو لم يحصل لم يكن علما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author cites the saying that when the one who loves has mastery over someone, nothing disliked occurs within that lover's domain.
rows.anchor: من يتسلط عليه من يحبه لم يجر في ملكه ما يكرهه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human exertion cannot alter God's decree or turn back His will; the accompanying poem pictures someone who could have been guided or given drink only if God had willed it.
rows.anchor: فما تفعل في قضائي كيف تبدله ؟ وما تصنع في مشيئتي بأي وسع تردها ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhammad is not related to the audience as a father to sons, yet the author describes his care for them as fatherly compassion.
rows.anchor: لم يكن مضافا إلى ولد فله عليكم شفقة الآباء . . ولكن ليس بأبيكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though the Prophet's lineage is publicly known, his lasting identity is his messengership, not his ancestry.
rows.anchor: ويقال نسبه ظاهر . ولكن إنما يعرف بي لا بنسبه ؛ فقلما يقال : محمد بن عبد الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The confession of faith joins God's oneness to Muhammad's messengership as the emblem of belief.
rows.anchor: وشعار الإيمان وكلمة التوحيد - بعد لا إله إلا الله - محمد رسول الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Love of God entails abundant remembrance, since people often mention what they love; heart remembrance can continue, while unceasing verbal remembrance is difficult.
rows.anchor: من أحب شيئا أكثر من ذكره ) فيجب أن تقول الله ، ثم لا تنس الله بعد ذكرك الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Morning and evening glorification is described in two terms so that remembrance does not become tiresome.
rows.anchor: التسبيح من قبيل الذكر ، ولكنه ذكره بلفظين لئلا تعتريك سآمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer means supplication: God's prayer draws people near, while the angels supplicate for forgiveness for sinners and beneficence for the obedient.
rows.anchor: فصلاته - سبحانه - دعاؤه لنا بالتقريب ، وصلاة الملائكة دعاؤهم إليه لنا : بالغفران للعاصي ، وبالإحسان للمطيع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes God's prayer as mercy and the angels' prayer as intercession.
rows.anchor: الصلاة من الله بمعنى الرحمة ، ومن الملائكة بمعنى الشفاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outwardly, God brings believers from disbelief's darkness into faith's light.
rows.anchor: ما ظلمات الكفر إلى نور الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The inward readings include rescue from error through connection, from self-directed planning into witnessing divine decree, from the self's darkness into insight, and from separation into realized unity.
rows.anchor: ويقال ليخرجكم من الظلمات إلى النور أي يعصمكم من الضلال بروح الوصال . ويقال ليخرجكم من ظلمات التدبير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further inward reading is that God protects believers from associating partners with Him and confirms them through signs of faith.
rows.anchor: ويقال يصونكم من الشرك ، ويثبتكم بشواهد الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When greeting is joined to vision and meeting to greeting, the passage indicates sight with the eyes; a kingly salutation is heard and delivered in a face-to-face encounter.
rows.anchor: التحية إذا قرنت بالرؤية ، واللقاء إذا قرن بالتحية فلا يكون ذلك إلا بمعنى رؤية البصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A generous reward is a good reward without meanness; by analogy, the Generous Lord does not meticulously count a great reward against a small deed, displaying prior grace.
rows.anchor: فإن الكريم لا يستقصي عند البيع والشراء في الأعداد ، وذلك تعريف بالإحسان السابق في وقت غيبتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet was sent as a witness to God's oneness and to the truth of following him, warning against disobedience and teaching people reverent fear.
rows.anchor: إنا أرسلناك شاهدا بوحدانيتنا ، وشاهدا تبشر بمتابعتنا ، وتحذر من مخالفة أمرنا ، وتعلم الناس مواضع الخوف منا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet calls people to God by God's permission and serves as a lamp and sun whose light reaches those who believe in and follow him; only through his service do they reach God.
rows.anchor: وداعيا إلينا بنا ، وسراجا يستضيئون به ، وشمسا ينبسط شعاعها على جميع من صدقك ، وآمن بك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation concerns sinful people waiting between Fire and Garden: the damned are consumed by hardship and the blessed by their delights, so God tells them that He alone remains for them.
rows.anchor: أقوام في العرصة أصحاب ذنوب لم يدخلوا النار ، ولم يدخلوا الجنة بعد لعصيانهم ؛ فيقول الحق : عبدي . . أهل النار لا يتفرغون إليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation says the blessed are occupied in preparing to see their Lord, an exceptionally complete occupation that comforts rather than tires or isolates them.
rows.anchor: قيل شغلهم تأهبهم لرؤية مولاهم ، وذلك من أتم الأشغال ، وهي أشغال مؤنسة مريحة لا متعبة موحشة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bodily enjoyment with one's family does not conflict with witnessing the Lord; people already maintain knowledge of Him while attending to bodily needs.
rows.anchor: فلا تنافي بين اشتغالهم بأبدانهم مع أهلهم ، وشهودهم مولاهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul's occupation with its desires can leave the inner secrets free for witnessing when the senses are absent; seeing the Beloved without the self as watcher is supreme.
rows.anchor: شغل نفوسهم بشهواتها حتى يخلص الشهود لأسرارهم على غيبة من إحساس النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author records two readings of spouses: people matching them in state and rank, or their wives and consorts.
rows.anchor: قيل أشكالهم في الحال والمنزلة ، كقوله : { احشروا الذين ظلموا وأزواجهم } [ الصافات : 22 ] وقيل حظاياهم من زوجاتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fruit in Paradise is the portion of the soul; inwardly it can signify the ease of the present moment rather than ego's gratification.
rows.anchor: أي نصيب أنفسهم . ويقال الإشارة فيها إلى راحات الوقت دون حظوظ النفس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What the blessed call for is what they want, and their desires are granted; a claim made without right, however, is defective.
rows.anchor: ما يريدون ، ويقال تسلم لهم دواعيهم ، والدعوى - إذا كانت بغير حق - معلولة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blessed hear God's speech and greeting directly, without an intermediary; the words qawlan and min rabb emphasize that no envoy speaks it for Him.
rows.anchor: يسمعون كلامه وسلامه بلا واسطة ، وأكد ذلك بقوله : ( قولا ) . وبقوله : { من رب }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading makes the mercy God's granting the vision at the moment of greeting, thereby completing the blessing.
rows.anchor: الرحمة في تلك الحالة أن يرزقهم الرؤية في حال ما يسلم عليهم لتكمل لهم النعمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading makes the mercy God's protection from bewilderment during the greeting and encounter.
rows.anchor: ويقال الرحمة في ذلك الوقت أن ينقيهم في حال سماع السلام وحال اللقاء لئلا يصحبهم دهش ، ولا تلحقهم حيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording gives sinful believers hope, since sinners especially need mercy; it also teaches that arrival is through divine mercy rather than earned entitlement.
rows.anchor: ويقال إنما قال : { من رب رحيم } ليكون للعصاة من المؤمنين فيه نفس ، ولرجائهم مساغ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Freedom from a watcher and distance from an enemy are among the greatest gifts: friends receive nearness, while enemies endure punishment and veiling.
rows.anchor: غيبة الرقيب أتم نعمة ، وإبعاد العدو من أجل العوارف ؛ فالأولياء في إيجاب القربة ، والأعداء في العذاب والحجبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If a creature addressed another in this way, it would sound like a rebuke: the hearer had been warned repeatedly but disobeyed and wronged himself.
rows.anchor: فلم تقبلوا وعظي ، ولم تعملوا بأمري ، فأنتم خالفتم ، وعلى أنفسكم ظلمتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Supplicants should not ask for what disobeys God or for lowly worldly things, but should accept what their Lord chooses for them.
rows.anchor: والواجب ألا تطلب شيئا تكون فيه مخالفة لأمره ، وأن تتباعد عن سؤالك الأشيئاء الدنية والدنيوية ، وأن ترضى بما يختاره لك مولاك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sincerity in supplication means seeing the answer as coming only from God and seeing no entitlement in oneself, only His grace.
rows.anchor: ومن لإخلاص في الدعاء ألا ترى الإجابة إلا منه ، وألا ترى لنفسك استحقاقا إلا بفضله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If a request for one's own benefit is withheld, one should still continue worship, God's due; supplication is the core of worship.
rows.anchor: فإن الدعاء مخ العبادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A sincere person turns in need over matters not caused by personal wrongdoing, while also recognizing need arising from the spread of one's own offense.
rows.anchor: ومن الإخلاص في الدعاء أن تكون في حال الاضطرار لما لا يكون ابتداؤه جرما لك ، وتكون ضرورتك لسراية جنايتك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God raises sinners through rescue, the obedient through reward, saints through wonders, the needy through sufficiency, and knowers by stripping away every kind of desire.
rows.anchor: رافع الدرجات للعصاة بالنجاة ، وللمطيعين بالمثوبات ، ولأصفياء والأولياء بالكرامات ، ولذوي الحاجات بالكفايات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The obedient rise through outward deeds in Paradise; knowers rise inwardly in this world above looking toward or settling in either world, while lovers seek only the beloved's pleasure.
rows.anchor: ويقال درجات المطيعين بظواهرهم في الجنة ، ودرجات العارفين بقلوبهم في الدنيا ؛ فيرفع درجاتهم عن النظر إلى الكونين دون المساكنه إليهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Throne's owner is the possessor of exalted dominion; the created Throne is also the direction of prayer and greatest created body.
rows.anchor: { ذو العرش } : ذو الملك الرفيع . ويقال العرش الذي هو قبلة الدعاء ، خلقه أرفع المخلوقات وأعظمها جثة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spirit sent by God's command can mean bodily life and intellect, illumination of hearts and healing knowledge, or spirits' life through abiding in God.
rows.anchor: روح بها ضياء أبدانهم - وهو سلطان عقولهم ، وروح بهاء ضياء قلوبهم - وهو شفاء علومهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other readings distinguish a spirit of inspiration, information, or honor, and spirits of prophethood, messengership, sainthood, and gnosis.
rows.anchor: ويقال : روح هو روح إلهام ، وورح هو روح إعلام ، وروح هو روح إكرام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spirit may also signify what sustains creation or illuminates the Real.
rows.anchor: ويقال : روح بها بقاء الخلق ، وروح بها ضياء الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows what exists and what is absent, past and future, what cannot occur, and how a possible event would unfold if it occurred.
rows.anchor: يعلم الحاصل الموجود ، ويعلم المعدوم المفقود ؛ والذي كان والذي يكون ، والذي لا يكون مما علم أنه لا يجوز أن يكون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's dominion is never limited to a particular day or time; judgment day instead exposes human claims of ownership and their illusions as baseless.
rows.anchor: لا يتقيد ملكه بيوم ، ولا يختص ملكه بوقت ، ولكن دعاوى الخلق - اليوم - لا أصل لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God rewards deeds with Gardens, states with good pleasure, breaths with nearness, and love with vision; He rewards sinners' repentance with forgiveness and their weeping with light and healing.
rows.anchor: يجازيهم على أعمالهم بالجنان ، وعلى أحوالهم بالرضوان ، وعلى أنفاسهم بالقربه ، وعلى محبتهم بالرؤية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The denial of injustice means injustice by God is impossible; whatever He does is His to do.
rows.anchor: { لا ظلم اليوم } : أي أنه يستحيل تقدير الظلم منه ، وكل ما يفعل فله أن يفعله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God reckons swiftly with all because nothing distracts Him from another matter, and He immediately accounts for even the smallest details of His friends' conduct.
rows.anchor: { إن الله سريع الحساب } مع عباده ؛ لا يشغله شأن عن شأن ، وسريع الحساب مع أوليائه في الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: While the universal Resurrection is delayed, lovers undergo a standing in every breath through punishment, reward, distance, and nearness; their bodies, tears, hearts, and color reveal what they conceal.
rows.anchor: قيامة الكل مؤجلة ، وقامة المحبين معجلة ؛ فلهم في كل نفس قيامة من العقاب والعذاب والثواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lovers' bodies offer four witnesses to their love: bodily melting, trembling limbs, a fluttering heart, and a tongue arrested from speech.
rows.anchor: لي في محبته شهود أربع . . . وشهود كل قضية اثنان ذوبان جسمي وارتعاد مفاصلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At departure, lovers' hearts reach their throats and their eyes overflow as the call to leave is made and the mounts are readied.
rows.anchor: وقلوبهم - إذا أزف الرحيل بلغت الحناجر ، وعيونهم شرقت بدموعها إذا نودي بالرحيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A lover's treacherous glance is admiration of anything besides the Beloved; the cited verses describe the eyes' punishment for looking at another.
rows.anchor: فخائنة أعين المحبين استحسانهم شيئا ، ولهذا قالوا : يا قرة العين : سل عيني هل اكتحلت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another betrayal is that lovers' eyes fall asleep during intimate prayer; a story about David calls false the claim of love when night comes and the lover sleeps.
rows.anchor: ومن خائنة أعينهم أن تأخذهم السنة والسبات في أوقات المناجاة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gnostics' eyes betray them when their hearts hold knowledge of what their eyes see.
rows.anchor: ومن خائنة أعين العارفين أن يكون لهم خبر بقلوبهم عما تقع عليه عيونهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The monotheists' eyes betray them if a tear regrets losing a creature in either world or grieves for themselves.
rows.anchor: ومن خائنة أعين الموحدين أن تخرج منها قطرة دمع تأسفا على مخلوق يفوت في الدنيا والآخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For lovers, looking in any way at someone other than the Beloved is a betrayal; the author invokes the saying that love blinds and deafens.
rows.anchor: ومن خائنة أعين المحبين النظر إلى غير المحبوب بأي وجه كان ، ففي الخبر : ( حبك الشيء يعمي ويصم )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nothing hidden in people's breasts escapes God's knowledge.
rows.anchor: { وما تخفى الصدور } : فالحق به خبير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The word thumma allows a temporal interval: the believers may already be upright now, then continue steadfastly in faith until death, their final accountable state.
rows.anchor: ( ثم ) استقاموا : ثم حرف يقتضي التراخي ، فهو لا يدل على انهم في الحال لا يكونون مستقيمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading is that they first professed faith in response to the call, then gained insight through proof rather than remaining imitators or keeping words without purified conduct.
rows.anchor: ويقال : قالوا بشرط الاستجابة أولا ، ثم استبصروا بموجب الحجة ، ولم يثبتوا على وصف التقليد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Steadfastness means holding firm to every condition of faith without neglecting any part.
rows.anchor: الاستقامة هي الثبات على شرائط الإيمان بجملتها من غير إخلال بشيء من أقسامها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One kind of steadfastness in the foundations of divine unity and gnosis characterizes all believers; steadfastness in practical branches without sin varies among people.
rows.anchor: ويقال : هم على قسمين . مستقيم ( في أصول ) التوحيد والمعرفة . . وهذه صفة جميع المؤمنين . ومستقيم في الفروع من غير عصيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anyone steadfast in monotheism and free of association with God is promised safety from remaining eternally in the Fire.
rows.anchor: { وأبشروا بالجنة } : الذي لهم البشارة هم كل من استقام في التوحيد ، ولم يشرك . فله الأمان من الخلود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Basic steadfastness ensures freedom from eternal Fire; complete steadfastness protects one from the threat without any harm touching at all.
rows.anchor: ويقال : من كان له أصل الاستقامة أمن من الخلود في النار ، ومن كمال الاستقامة أمن من الوعيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Steadfastness takes degrees: keeping covenant, maintaining creed, exerting effort and observing limits, with love and devotion marking its fullest form.
rows.anchor: ثم الاستقامة لهم على حسب أحوالهم ؛ فمستقيم في عهده ، ومستقيم في عقده ، ومستقيم في جهده ومراعاة حده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other inward readings describe continuous witnessing and a heart devoted to God, or purity of creed, fulfillment of covenant, and sound purpose sustained by yearning.
rows.anchor: ويقال : استقاموا على دوام الشهود وعلى انفراد القلب بالله . ويقال : استقاموا في تصفية العقد ثم في توفية العهد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Steadfastness can proceed from words to deeds to purified states, or mean obeying God, knowing Him, loving Him intensely, and observing the conditions of service.
rows.anchor: ويقال : استقاموا بأقوالهم ثم بأعمالهم ، ثم بصفاء أحوالهم في وقتهم وفي مآلهم . ويقال : أقاموا على طاعته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For an ascetic, steadfastness is not returning to worldly life or letting public standing distract from God; for a gnostic, it is keeping knowledge free of worldly and otherworldly interests that veil the Lord.
rows.anchor: ويقال : استقامة الزاهد ألا يرجع إلى الدنيا ، وألا يمنعه الجاه بين الناس عن الله . واستقامة العارف ألا يشوب معرفته حظ في الدارين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For a worshipper, steadfastness means avoiding lethargy, desire, and ostentation; for a lover, it means seeking no personal gain from the Beloved and being content with His abiding presence.
rows.anchor: واستقامة العابد ألا يعود إلى فترته واتباع شهوته ، ولا يتداخله رياء وتصنع واستقامة المحب ألا يكون له أرب من محبوبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fear concerns what may happen next—an arriving harm or a lost beloved—so the angels promise that every desired good will come and every feared evil will not.
rows.anchor: { ألا تخافوا ولا تحزنوا } : إنما يكون الخوف في المستقل من الوقت ، ومن حلول مكروه أو فوات محبوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sorrow comes from the hardship of one's present state; whoever accepts what unfolds has no sorrow, and the angels promise the believers spiritual ease and rest.
rows.anchor: والحزن من حزونه الوقت ، ومن كان راضيا بما يجري فلا حزن له في عيشه . والملائكة يبشرونهم بأنهم لا حزنه في أحوالهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promise of Paradise means a good return and the beautiful reward God has promised.
rows.anchor: { وأبشروا بالجنة } : أي بحسن المآب ، وبما وعد الله من جميل الثواب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What the angels promise later is already given now by God to His special servants; living by the present moment leaves them without anticipatory fear or sorrow.
rows.anchor: والذي هو موعود للأولياء بسفارة الملك موجود اليوم لخواص عباده بعطاء الملك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation reads the reassurance as freedom from punishment, grief over the means left behind, and joy in the reward of the final abode.
rows.anchor: يمكن القول : { لا تخافوا } من العذاب ، { ولا تحزنوا } على ماخلفتم من الأسباب ، { وأبشروا } بحسن الثواب في المآب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading promises that their divine friendship will not be withdrawn, their past offenses need not grieve them, and God's care was already beautiful from the beginning.
rows.anchor: ويقال : { لا تخافوا } من عزل الولاية ، { ولا تحزنوا } على ما أسلفتم من الجناية ، ( وأبشروا ) بحسن العناية في البداية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further reading tells them not to fear for what they did, not to grieve what they left, and to rejoice in the Garden for which they labored.
rows.anchor: ويقال : { لا تخافوا } مما أسلفتم ، { ولا تحزنوا } على ما خلفتم ، { وأبشروا } بالجنة التي لها تكلفتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading promises safety from humiliation, relief from grief over past slips, and enduring union with God.
rows.anchor: ويقال : { لا تخافوا } المذلة ، { ولا تحزنوا } على ما أسلفتم من الزلة ، { وأبشروا } بدوام الوصلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine walaya can mean love or support; the reassurance may be spoken by the descending angels or may begin as direct speech from God.
rows.anchor: الولاية من الله بمعنى المحبة ، وتكون بمعنى النصرة . وهذا الخطاب يحتمل أن يكون من قبل الملائكة الذين تنزلوا عيلهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Divine support in the present proceeds from primordial love; without eternal love, there would be no present aid.
rows.anchor: والنصرة تصدر من المحبة ؛ فلو لم تكن المحبة الأزلية لم تحصل النصرة في الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author's paired readings of divine friendship include gnosis or care in this life, and forgiveness, sufficiency, vision, meeting, faith, pardon, love, or nearness in the next.
rows.anchor: ويقال : { نحن أولياؤكم فى الحياة الدنيا } بتحقيق المعرفة ، { وفى الأخرة } بتحصيل المغفرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Garden contains everything its inhabitants desire; divine friendship is a present gift, while fulfillment of desires is a future promise, so those occupied with the present gift scarcely attend to the promise.
rows.anchor: { ولكم فيها } أي في الجنة { ما تشتهى أنفسكم } : الولاية نقد ، وتحصيل الشهوات وعد ، فمن يشتغل بنقده قلما يشتغل بوعده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What people call for means what they want and ask God to give them.
rows.anchor: { ولكم فيها ما تدعون } : أي ما تريدون ، وتدعون الله ليعطيكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The term nuzul means a gift or provision given in advance of the endless forms of divine favor.
rows.anchor: { نزلا } : أي فضلا وعطاء ، وتقدمة لما يستديم إلى الأبد من فنون الأفضال ووجوه المبار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The addressee should strive without falling short, trust God without slackening, stop where commanded, and remain confident that the path is straight.
rows.anchor: اجتهد من غير تقصير وتوكل على الله من غير فتور ، وقف حيثما أمرت ، وثق بأنك على صراط مستقيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is a remembrance for Muhammad and his people: a source of honor, good reputation, and an entitled rank; they will be questioned about it.
rows.anchor: أي إن هذا القرآن لذكر لك ؛ أي شرف لك ، وحسن صيت ، واستحقاق منزلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One report says the prophets' spirits were assembled on the Night Journey and Muhammad was told to ask whether God had commanded worship of any other deity; he did not doubt or ask.
rows.anchor: حشر أرواح الأنبياء - عليهم السلام - ليلة الإسراء ، وقيل له - : ( سلهم : هل أمرنا أحدا بعبادة غيرنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes Muhammad as the direct addressee but someone else as the intended audience, since no one could doubt the answer.
rows.anchor: ويقال : الخطاب له ، ولمراد به غيره . . فمن يرتاب في ذلك ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further interpretation is that he should ask the prophets' communities, whose denial that God commanded other worship would make the proof more decisive.
rows.anchor: ويقال : المراد منه سل أقوامهم ، لكي إذا قالوا إن الله لم يمر بذلك كان هذا أبلغ في إبرام الحجة عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses was sent to Pharaoh and the Copts with clear signs and decisive miracles, but they met him with mockery, laughter, and denial; repeated signs only made their response more discourteous.
rows.anchor: أرسلناه بالمعجزات إلى فرعون وقومه من القبط ، فقوبل بالهزء والضحك والتكذيب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the affliction pressed them, they called Moses a sorcerer and asked him to pray for its removal, promising belief; after God removed it, they returned to disbelief and broke their pledge.
rows.anchor: فلما عضهم الأمر قالوا : يا أيها الساحر ، أدع لنا ربك ليكشف عنا البلية لنؤمن بك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh boasted of his Egyptian kingdom and the Nile running beneath him, and this became his ruin; whoever exalts himself through anything besides God will find destruction in that very thing.
rows.anchor: تعزز بملك مصر ، وجري النيل بأمره ! وكان في ذلك هلاكه ؛ ليعلم أن من تعزز بشيء من دون الله فحتفه وهلاكه في ذلك الشيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh belittled Moses as poor and inarticulate, but God empowered Moses against him and made him the cause of Pharaoh's death; whoever scorns another may be placed under that person's power.
rows.anchor: استصغر موسى وحديثه ، وعابه بالفقر . . فسلطه الله عليه ، وكان هلاكه بيديه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh's people obeyed him from fear, which is not sincere obedience; genuine obedience arises from willingness.
rows.anchor: أطاعوه طاعة الرهبة ، وطاعة ’ الرهبة لا تكون مخلصة ، وإنما تكون الطاعة صادقة إذا صدرت عن الرغبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase they angered Us means they angered God's allies, whose offense is attributed to God Himself by a rhetorical principle of union.
rows.anchor: { فلمآ ءاسفونا انتقمنا منهم فأغرقناهم أجمعين } . { ءاسفونا } أغضبونا ، وإنما أراد أغضبوا أولياءنا ، فانتقمنا منهم
